business_problem: Santander aims to extend AI-powered automation beyond specific tasks to more complex processes that can scale across markets, while keeping process execution traceable, auditable, reproducible, and governed.
solution_summary: Banco Santander is extending its AI-powered automation beyond individual tasks to more complex operational processes under One Transformation, with Maisa's technology supporting systems that combine reasoning and execution. For each run, the technology records the information used, the steps followed, and how the outcome was reached, making execution traceable, auditable, and reproducible for regulatory requirements. Santander says this traceability supports training specialized process models and deploying them across its infrastructure under governance and cost-efficiency controls; capabilities can then be reused across processes and markets. The source does not name data-ingestion or storage services, model architectures, runtime components, or downstream systems, so those implementation details cannot be specified. Santander's own teams can develop automation within a shared technology and governance framework; hundreds of use cases are already in production across Europe and the Americas.

solution_components.name: Maisa
solution_components.role: Supports Santander's AI systems for process automation, recording the information and steps for each run to make outcomes traceable, auditable, and reproducible.

business_outcome: Santander reports hundreds of use cases in production with Maisa support across its main markets in Europe and the Americas. The model is intended to enable reuse across processes and markets and to free time for higher-value tasks.
